title: Field Sales Executive
description:
**Location:** Tirupur, Tamil Nadu, India  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Work Mode:** Field Work  
**Compensation:** Fixed Salary + Performance-Based Incentives

**Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Field Sales Executive to generate leads, acquire customers, and develop business relationships. The candidate must be comfortable visiting businesses, meeting decision-makers, conducting product demonstrations, and driving customer onboarding.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Follow up with prospects and convert leads into active customers.
* Coordinate customer onboarding and maintain business relationships.
* Maintain an updated customer database and submit daily progress reports.
* Achieve agreed sales and onboarding targets.

**Requirements**

* Proven experience in field sales, B2B sales, or business development.
* Demonstrated ability to generate leads and convert prospects into customers.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Experience meeting business owners and decision-makers.
* Basic computer skills and familiarity with Excel or Google Sheets.
* Willingness to travel locally and conduct regular customer visits.
* Ability to work independently and deliver results with minimal supervision.

**Compensation**

Fixed monthly salary plus performance-based incentives. Travel reimbursement or allowance will be discussed during recruitment.

**How to Apply**

Submit your updated CV, highlighting your relevant sales experience, previous achievements, current location, availability, and expected salary.

title: Collection Executive
description:
**Job Title**: Collection Executive

**Location:** Tirupur, Tamil Nadu

**Experience Required**: 1-2 Years

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a responsible and proactive Collection Executive to manage customer outstanding payments, follow up on overdue invoices, and ensure timely collection of receivables. The candidate will coordinate with customers, the sales team, and the accounts department to maintain healthy cash flow and minimize overdue payments.

Roles and Responsibilities

* **Payment Follow-up:** Regularly contact customers to follow up on outstanding payments and ensure timely collection as per agreed credit terms.
* **Outstanding Management:** Monitor customer outstanding balances, overdue invoices, and payment due dates.
* **Customer Coordination:** Communicate with textile buyers, dealers, and other customers regarding pending payments and payment commitments.
* **Accounts Coordination:** Coordinate with the accounts department to verify invoices, payment receipts, credit notes, and outstanding balances.
* **Collection Planning:** Prepare daily and weekly collection plans to achieve assigned collection targets.
* **Overdue Recovery:** Identify overdue accounts, understand reasons for delayed payments, and take appropriate follow-up action.
* **Customer Visits:** Visit customers when required for payment collection, account reconciliation, and resolving payment-related issues.
* **Payment Tracking:** Maintain accurate records of customer follow-ups, promised payment dates, collection status, and pending amounts.
* **Dispute Resolution:** Coordinate with sales and accounts teams to resolve invoice discrepancies, rate differences, shortages, quality claims, and other payment disputes.
* **Collection Reporting:** Submit daily and weekly collection reports to management, highlighting collections achieved, overdue amounts, and pending commitments.
* **Relationship Management:** Maintain professional relationships with customers while ensuring timely payment realization.
* **Credit Control Support:** Inform management about customers with repeated payment delays and potential credit risks.

Apply through Indeed

Work Location: In person

title: Sales Manager – Apparel Automation & Machinery
description:
**Company Name:** AM Automation Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

**About AM Automation Solutions Pvt. Ltd.**

AM Automation Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a provider of apparel automation and machinery solutions, offering a broad range of high-quality equipment to meet the evolving needs of the apparel industry. With a focus on precision, efficiency, innovation and customer satisfaction, the company supports customers through machinery procurement, installation, training and after-sales service.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a dynamic and target-oriented **Sales Manager** to drive sales growth, develop new business opportunities and strengthen customer relationships in the apparel automation and machinery sector. The ideal candidate should have experience in B2B sales, customer acquisition, market development and sales target achievement, preferably in industrial machinery, textile machinery or apparel automation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
* Identify and acquire new customers, including garment manufacturers, apparel exporters, knitting units and textile factories.
* Generate leads through market visits, networking, customer references and other business development activities.
* Promote and sell apparel automation machinery, equipment and related solutions.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing customers and prospective clients.
* Conduct customer visits, product presentations and machinery demonstrations.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable machinery and automation solutions.
* Handle enquiries, prepare quotations, negotiate commercial terms and close sales orders.
* Develop new markets, expand the customer base and identify opportunities for repeat business.
* Monitor competitor activities, market trends, customer demands and new business opportunities.
* Coordinate with the Technical, Service and Installation teams to ensure smooth execution of customer orders.
* Monitor sales pipelines, follow up on pending quotations and support timely payment collection.
* Prepare sales forecasts, customer visit reports and periodic sales performance reports.
* Lead, guide and monitor sales team members to achieve individual and overall sales targets, as applicable.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Business Administration, Marketing, Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.
* 4–8 years of relevant experience in sales, business development or B2B sales.
* Experience in industrial machinery, apparel machinery, textile machinery or automation is preferred.
* Proven ability to generate leads, acquire customers, negotiate and close sales.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and interpersonal skills.
* Good customer relationship management and market development capabilities.
* Ability to work independently, achieve targets and manage customer accounts.
* Willingness to travel regularly for customer visits and business development.
* Two-wheeler and valid driving licence required for customer visits.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Performance-based incentives, subject to company policy.
* Opportunity to contribute to business expansion in the apparel automation industry.

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Tirupur North, Tamil Nadu: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)
